# HagiCode Gallery

> Browse images from HagiCode's img-gen pipeline. Every image shows its prompts, seed and generation details.

## Overview

- [HagiCode Gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/): Browse images from HagiCode's img-gen pipeline. Every image shows its prompts, seed and generation details.

## Albums

- [Agent CLI default cats](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/agent-cli-default-cats/): Default cat avatars for agent CLI sessions. 1 image
- [Cat head gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/cat-head-gallery/): Cat head portraits. 1,000 images
- [Claude antler girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/claude-antler-girl-gallery/): The Claude girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [DeepSeek whale girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/deepseek-whale-girl-gallery/): The whale-maid character drawn in many styles, proportions and scenes. 1,000 images
- [Doubao sunny girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/doubao-sunny-girl-gallery/): The Doubao girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [Gemini twin-star girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/gemini-twin-star-girl-gallery/): The Gemini girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [GLM black book girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/glm-black-book-girl-gallery/): The GLM girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [GPT knot girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/gpt-knot-girl-gallery/): The GPT girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [Grok punk girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/grok-punk-girl-gallery/): The Grok girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [Hero avatars](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/hero-avatars/): Avatar portraits for the hero section. 132 images
- [Hunyuan neon girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/hunyuan-neon-girl-gallery/): The Hunyuan girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
- [Kimi moon girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/kimi-moon-girl-gallery/): The Kimi girl, drawn in many styles and scenes. 1,000 images
